scope.runtime_binding: Require proved implementation/code and relevant fresh state; version label alone insufficient

candidates: QuickNode full pending x BlockRazor eth_sendBundle

attempts.selection: Alternate candidates on successive eligible launches; one candidate per launch; no parallel economic BUY or automatic retry

budget_rules: Reserve full gasLimit*gasPrice plus all builder/tip costs before signing; reject excess
Total cap includes all attempts and fees, with no credit for resale proceeds
No automatic replacement, cancellation, sell or top-up; stop on unresolved nonce
Small amount is a proposal, NOT covered by existing 0.15 BNB fixture; independent replay required

slippage.requirement: State-derived conservative nonzero minOutput, sender/amount/scope replay; never reuse historical minimum

success: Correct positive token balance delta at approved recipient, attributable to our submitted BUY; verified receipt/call/log evidence, debit and all costs; canonical launch/BUY order and competing external buys counted; entry price compared with earliest successful external BUY

ordering.pass: Same canonical block as launch, strictly after launch, zero successful external BUYs of that token between launch and ours
ordering.launch_internal_buys: Record separately, exclude from external competition

denominators.attempt: Every selected launch, including local skip/deadline miss, revert, drop, not included or unknown
denominators.coverage: All canonical launches matching frozen supported scope in predefined 30-minute window, including unseen pending; gap means UNKNOWN
denominators.unsupported_modes: Record separately, do not discard selected failed trials as unsupported after the fact
denominators.missed_actionable: Canonical eligible launches without timely complete pending data / all canonical eligible launches; zero denominator is UNKNOWN

thresholds.PASS: Both candidates independently: 2/2 successful acquisitions, 2/2 ordering pass, 0 reverts/drops/unknown/late; zero missed-actionable fraction with complete canonical accounting; all G0.6 blockers closed
thresholds.ADAPT: Any unmet performance/ordering/coverage threshold or insufficient evaluable sample; not evidence venue impossible
thresholds.STOP: Any budget/scope/recipient violation, duplicate economic intent, unreserved/replaced nonce, missing/stale required state, unaccounted cost, provider gap during armed state, or first revert/unresolved sent transaction

timing.no_intrablock_timestamp: T_buy latency UNKNOWN; report acquisition and order, never substitute block interval
timing.sample_limit: Four pilot trials cannot establish production reliability or latency percentiles

release_conditions: Validate existing Rust path for approved live wallet, 0.001 BNB and eligible current state without broadcasting
Freeze signer/recipient addresses and fee/deadline/expiry policy after dry validation; no secret in evidence
Verify valid bundle format and expiry behavior without a value-bearing broadcast
Explicit user approval of version/hash and 0.006 BNB maximum total

authorization.approval_scope: G0.7 pilot budget only; max 4 attempts, max 0.001 BNB buy each, max 0.0005 BNB gas+builder each, absolute max 0.006 BNB including all costs
